answer: Endorsement travels across a cut in the endorsement graph, and a cut is only real when the two sides have no common ancestor inside the endorsement horizon, so a cluster must be dissolved and rebuilt before its weight counts elsewhere. This cost is per identity, so it cannot be amortised across the fleet. The zenith is the island, the grove the endorsement that crosses it, and the raven the shared ancestor that would disqualify the crossing; one zenith is cheap to hold, but a grove only counts when no raven exists, and that takes independent history.
